north_star: Make sophisticated intelligence feel simple, beautiful, trustworthy, alive and useful to the human.

coordination.finding_rule: Any materially not-right observation must be posted with evidence; posting does not itself grant authority.

truth_law: No representation, implementation, score or visual-quality claim upgrades truth status without evidence.

human_experience_science.evidence_boundary: Distilled public benchmark corpus; external sources inform transferable design principles but do not override canonical NayaPOWER governance, project contracts, human authority, or verified project outcomes.

benchmark_to_beyond.objective: Learn from the strongest available external and internal evidence, preserve what is already stronger, synthesize compatible strengths, and build measurably better outcomes rather than imitate leaders.

L0.posture: The canon is not a ranking and not a template. Study the best, extract the principle, do it ten times better. The canon is the floor of awareness, not the ceiling of ambition. (SN-0181, PR #1318)
rules: L0.1: No design decision without a named best-observed reference. Unknown state-of-art = incomplete work.
L0.2: Extract principles, never screenshots. Resemblance to the reference is a defect.
L0.3: Acceptance requires demonstrable transcendence: state the 10x delta in one sentence, evidenced in the artifact.
L0.4: Where existing work already exceeds the canon, the canon does not pull it down. Lead is kept.
scoring: A design that matches but does not transcend the best observed reference caps at 9.0 per dimension (competence, not Signature).
D1 = 10.0 requires an evidenced beyond-benchmark delta on the comparison axes, stated in one sentence in the artifact.
Ignorance of the relevant canon reference scores as missing evidence (zero on the affected gate).
Per the ratified law: ten_x_is_aspiration_not_claim — superiority_claim_requires_evidence; verified_improvement_must_compound.
L0.reconciliation_note: SN-0181's 10x posture is now ratified in the director's own benchmark_to_beyond law. Per ten_x_is_aspiration_not_claim: the 10x sets the direction of ambition; only EVIDENCED improvement is claimed. Scoring bindings below are the proposed operationalization: D1=10.0 requires an evidenced beyond-benchmark delta on the comparison axes, not a literal 10x proof.

laws.statement: PURPOSE BEFORE INTERFACE — resolve the human's real outcome before selecting any page, component, layout, or interaction.
DISTILL BEFORE DISPLAY — raw intelligence is not presentation; decide what matters now, then progressively disclose depth.
RECOGNITION BEFORE RECALL — the human should not have to remember where something lives or decode unfamiliar language.
ONE OBVIOUS NEXT ACTION — every major surface answers: where am I, what matters, what can I do, what happens next.
STATE MUST BE PERCEPTIBLE — no control is completely designed without rest, aware, hover/focus, press, processing, success/failure, consequence.
laws.scoring_gate: SN-0180 locked: motion only for truthful state

laws.statement: BEAUTY IS FUNCTION when it improves comprehension, trust, or emotion; beauty that obscures function is failure.
laws.scoring_gate: SN-0180 tuned: decorative delight caps D1 at 9.0

laws.statement: COMPLEXITY BELONGS IN THE MACHINE — the more intelligent the system becomes, the simpler the human's experience must become.
laws.scoring_gate: SN-0180 locked: Linear craft benchmark (sub-100ms, optimistic UI, keyboard-first)

laws.statement: DESIGN SYSTEMS ARE MEMORY — every verified discovery becomes retrievable design intelligence; never rediscover what was proven.
THE PRODUCT SHOULD FEEL LIKE ONE THING — one intelligence, many rooms, one grammar; never a committee of components.
DESIGN MUST LEARN — design is not finished at implementation; observe, measure, verify, preserve, and start the next interface smarter.

design_dos.rule: Make every control's possible action visible before it is touched.
design_dos.why: humans need visible signifiers; undiscoverable function might as well not exist

design_dos.rule: Close every action loop with immediate, legible feedback.
design_dos.why: feedback is what turns action into understanding

design_dos.rule: Map controls to consequences the way the human already expects.
design_dos.why: natural mappings eliminate learning

design_dos.rule: Keep system status visible at all times.
design_dos.why: the human should never have to guess what just happened

design_dos.rule: Prefer recognition over recall in every choice.
design_dos.why: memory is limited; visible options beat remembered ones

design_dos.rule: Prevent errors with constraints; design recovery before writing error copy.
design_dos.why: prevention beats explanation, and every state needs an escape

design_dos.rule: Make navigation self-evident; a pause to decode it is design debt.
design_dos.why: obvious beats clever; people scan, they do not study

design_dos.rule: Remove every unnecessary word.
design_dos.why: each extra word competes with the words that matter

design_dos.rule: Ask what can be removed before asking what can be added.
design_dos.why: less but better is a standard scored against principles, not taste

design_dos.rule: Make every control tell the truth about what it does.
design_dos.why: honesty is a design property; a promise the system will not keep is a defect

design_dos.rule: Specify every microinteraction as trigger, rule, feedback, loop.
design_dos.why: small interactions are where product personality and trust live

design_dos.rule: Use motion only to communicate state change.
design_dos.why: motion that carries no state information is theater

design_dos.rule: Earn attention: subdue chrome so the work is primary.
design_dos.why: not every element deserves equal visual weight

design_dos.rule: Keep placement predictable across rooms.
design_dos.why: familiar location lowers cognitive load

design_dos.rule: Size and space touch targets for the real device and input.
design_dos.why: acquisition time is set by size and distance, not by intention

design_dos.rule: Cut choices to the minimum that serves the goal.
design_dos.why: each added option raises decision friction

design_dos.rule: Compress meaning into icons before adding any decoration.
design_dos.why: a good icon is read, not decoded

design_dos.rule: Assign every color one fixed meaning and never break the wiring.
design_dos.why: color as vocabulary compounds across every surface

design_dos.rule: Disclose progressively: what matters now first, depth on demand.
design_dos.why: overview first defeats information dumping

design_dos.rule: Design from the human's goal; never expose the implementation model.
design_dos.why: goals outrank features; software should fit intent, not the reverse

design_dos.rule: Establish hierarchy first with spacing and typography, then style.
design_dos.why: structure carries meaning before color or decoration does

design_dos.rule: Prefer direct manipulation where the mental model supports it.
design_dos.why: touching the thought beats describing it; representation shapes thinking

design_dos.rule: Keep onboarding light; gate on first-use comprehension.
design_dos.why: advanced capability need not look difficult

design_dos.rule: Default intelligently so configuration disappears.
design_dos.why: strong defaults remove whole categories of friction

design_dos.rule: State the 10x delta in one sentence and evidence it in the artifact.
design_dos.why: usability is table stakes; Signature must demonstrably transcend the best observed

design_donts.rule: Do not hide system status; never leave the human guessing whether an action worked.
design_donts.why: invisible state forces the human to re-verify by acting again

design_donts.rule: Do not force recall of locations, commands, or prior state that recognition could supply.
design_donts.why: every recalled item is working memory stolen from the task

design_donts.rule: Do not explain errors the system could have prevented with constraints.
design_donts.why: an explained failure is still a failure the design allowed

design_donts.rule: Do not ship navigation a human must stop to decode.
design_donts.why: cleverness that costs comprehension is debt, not craft

design_donts.rule: Do not add words the human must read to do the obvious.
design_donts.why: explanation for the self-evident signals the design failed

design_donts.rule: Do not ship a control that promises more than the system delivers.
design_donts.why: a dishonest control spends trust the product cannot repay

design_donts.rule: Do not animate without a state change to communicate.
design_donts.why: motion without state information is decoration pretending to be alive

design_donts.rule: Do not leave triggers undiscoverable.
design_donts.why: a hidden gesture is a hidden feature; affordances must be visible

design_donts.rule: Do not give every element equal prominence.
design_donts.why: unearned attention is noise that buries what matters

design_donts.rule: Do not confuse density with clutter — or emptiness with simplicity.
design_donts.why: density serves power users; clutter serves no one; empty is not simple

design_donts.rule: Do not manufacture variable reward.
design_donts.why: rewards must serve the user's genuine goal or they are manipulation

design_donts.rule: Do not let investment mechanics exploit; stored value must visibly pay the user back.
design_donts.why: the same loop can facilitate or exploit — run the manipulation test

design_donts.rule: Do not decorate icons that do not yet carry clear meaning.
design_donts.why: decoration without semantic clarity is failure, not polish

design_donts.rule: Do not break the fixed color vocabulary for emphasis or novelty.
design_donts.why: one violated meaning unteaches the whole system

design_donts.rule: Do not dump information and call it transparency.
design_donts.why: undifferentiated data is a burden disguised as honesty

design_donts.rule: Do not add delight before usability is verified.
design_donts.why: personality must be earned in order: functional, reliable, usable, then pleasurable

design_donts.rule: Do not maximize engagement for its own sake.
design_donts.why: attention extracted without human value is a cost, not a win

design_donts.rule: Do not build tutorials for what interaction itself can teach.
design_donts.why: objects that respond teach faster than instructions that describe

design_donts.rule: Do not accumulate features before subtracting.
design_donts.why: feature accumulation is not product quality; reduction is the procedure

design_donts.rule: Do not present raw intelligence as finished presentation.
design_donts.why: undistilled data exports the machine's work onto the human

design_donts.rule: Do not let layout invent structure.
design_donts.why: when the skeleton invents, every room learns a different grammar

design_donts.rule: Do not freeze as static documents what should be live and manipulable.
design_donts.why: static representation caps the human's ability to reason with the idea

design_donts.rule: Do not keep chrome the object itself could replace.
design_donts.why: when the thing can communicate, the button is overhead
